title: Riley Probable NDE 22432
content: I was hit by a car. The rest is really unspeakable. I was told not to tell, but I am.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Accident Life threatening event, but not clinical death I was hit by a car.
elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | Presence of deceased persons | Light | Strong emotional tone
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Yes I could see my own body in the streets.
elements.Please compare your hearing during the e: I heard dead people speaking as a legion of voices.
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Yes I met dead relatives and other unknown beings.
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control I wasn't in control.
